args.command:
cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
s='n1c(CN2C=CN(c3ccc(C#N)cc3)[C]2)cccc1CN4C=CN(c5ccc(C#N)cc5)[C]4'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
r=Chem.RWMol(m)
i=r.AddAtom(Chem.Atom('Cu'))
r.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetFormalCharge(1)
for k in [0,15,33]: r.AddBond(k,i,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=r.GetMol()
try:Chem.SanitizeMol(m);print('sanitize',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
except Exception as e:print('sanitize error',e)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('heavy',i,'n',m.GetNumAtoms())
par=AllChem.ETKDGv3();par.randomSeed=324;par.maxIterations=300;par.useRandomCoords=True
par.numThreads=4
for attempt in range(5):
  par.randomSeed=324+attempt
  res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,par)
  print('embed',attempt,res)
  if res==0:
   pos=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions());print('Cu-donor dist',[(j,round(np.linalg.norm(pos[i]-pos[j]),2)) for j in [0,15,33]],'central N-Cu-C',np.dot(pos[0]-pos[i],pos[15]-pos[i]))
   Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'/tmp/copper.mol')
   break
PY
python /tmp/build.py
